title: The 9 AI tools
I rely on
slides.subtitle: What each one does, and why I like it.

slides.label: Claude
slides.detail: AI chatbot. I use it to think through ideas, draft copy and work through tasks.
slides.start: It remembers our business context through Projects and connects to Gmail, Calendar and Drive.

slides.label: Granola
slides.detail: Note taking. It writes up my meetings so I can stay in the conversation.
slides.start: No bot joins the call, and I get the notes afterwards.

slides.label: Wispr Flow
slides.detail: Voice transcription. I speak and it types, in whichever app I am using.
slides.start: Talking is faster than typing, and it tidies up what I say.

slides.label: Claude Code
slides.detail: Coding. Where we build our own tools and automations.
slides.start: We built our daily content routine with it, from plain-English prompts.

slides.label: Higgsfield
slides.detail: Media generation. Images and video in one place.
slides.start: We use it for animated clips and our character images, including Kai.

slides.label: ElevenLabs
slides.detail: Text to voice. It turns a script into a natural voiceover.
slides.start: British voices that sound like a person, not a robot.

slides.label: Zernio
slides.detail: Social media scheduling. One place to post to LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok and X.
slides.start: One request publishes everywhere, and I can check each post landed.

slides.label: n8n
slides.detail: Automation. It connects our tools with no code.
slides.start: It runs our website and Google Business publishing and our spreadsheet updates.

slides.label: Calendly
slides.detail: Booking. How people book a call with us.
slides.start: A free 30 minute AI audit is a few taps away.
